name: mastermind
description: A desk for your Claude Code agents: who needs you, in every VS Code window.

commands.title: New Claude session on this file
Run the platform check's call file

mastermind.hookPort.description: The port Mastermind listens on for hook events and for its VS Code windows. A port Mastermind cannot listen on is refused with a warning. A change restarts Mastermind and moves the hook entries of every project watched from here; a manifest's projects move when whatever writes it runs again.

mastermind.debugPort.description: VS Code's remote-debugging-port (argv.json), which the panel's send, allow / deny and archive actions and VS Code health's Claude-panel memory reading drive; 0 = off. The walkthrough sets it up.

mastermind.startAtLogin.description: Start Mastermind when you log in to Windows — on this machine only; Settings Sync never carries it.

mastermind.newSessionAutoAllow.description: Every Claude session starts with auto-allow on — a new one, a /clear's and a resumed one, unless you switched a resumed one off on its card. Needs Mastermind running when the session starts.

mastermind.relay.description: Mastermind moves handoffs between projects (the relay).

mastermind.askToStart.description: A window that opens with no Mastermind running asks to start it.

mastermind.exePath.description: Mastermind.exe's full path on this machine.

include.description: Glob of the files the item shows on, from each workspace folder, e.g. docs/*.md — the folders before the first wildcard are the only ones searched.

exclude.description: Glob of the files left out, matched against each file's path under the include's fixed folder, where the search runs — start it with **/ to match at any depth, e.g. **/archive.md.

template.description: The prompt typed into the new session, unsent; {path} is the file's workspace-relative path.

mastermind.promptItem.markdownDescription: The explorer's right-click item: a new Claude session with `template` typed in, unsent, on files matching `include` minus `exclude`. An empty `include` shows no item.

mastermind.health.enabled.description: VS Code health: a status-bar item in each window shows its TypeScript, ESLint and Angular servers' and its Claude panel's memory past their warning share, a server in its error band restarts on its own, and Mastermind's tray marks a window in its error band.

mastermind.health.typescript.warningPerc.description: Share of the TypeScript server's heap cap from which the health item shows it.

mastermind.health.typescript.errorPercen.description: Share of the TypeScript server's heap cap from which the item turns red, the tray marks this window and an automatic restart becomes due.

mastermind.health.typescript.autoRestart.description: Restart the TypeScript server on its own in its error band, once no file has been opened, changed or closed for the quiet wait; at most once per cooldown.

mastermind.health.eslint.warningPercent.description: Share of the ESLint server's heap cap from which the health item shows it.

mastermind.health.eslint.errorPercent.description: Share of the ESLint server's heap cap from which the item turns red, the tray marks this window and an automatic restart becomes due.

mastermind.health.eslint.autoRestart.description: Restart the ESLint server on its own in its error band, once no file has been opened, changed or closed for the quiet wait; at most once per cooldown.

mastermind.health.angular.warningPercent.description: Share of the Angular server's heap cap from which the health item shows it.

mastermind.health.angular.errorPercent.description: Share of the Angular server's heap cap from which the item turns red, the tray marks this window and an automatic restart becomes due.

mastermind.health.angular.autoRestart.description: Restart the Angular server on its own in its error band, once no file has been opened, changed or closed for the quiet wait; at most once per cooldown.

mastermind.health.panel.warningPercent.description: Share of a Claude panel's heap cap — measured on this PC — read over the debug port, from which the health item shows it.

mastermind.health.panel.errorPercent.description: Share of a Claude panel's heap cap — measured on this PC — read over the debug port, from which the item turns red and the tray marks this window. The panel never reloads on its own.

mastermind.health.quietSeconds.description: How long no file may be opened, changed or closed before a server in its error band restarts on its own — a restart mid-load orphans its loading indicator.

mastermind.health.cooldownMinutes.description: The least time between two automatic restarts of one server.

walkthroughs.title: Set up Agent Mastermind
walkthroughs.description: Start Mastermind, and turn on the debug port if you want the panel's send, allow / deny and archive actions.

steps.title: Start Mastermind
steps.description:
Mastermind runs as its own app beside VS Code — the tray icon, the panel, and the badge in every window.
[Start Mastermind](command:mastermind.start)

steps.title: Turn on the debug port (optional)
steps.description:
The panel's send, allow / deny and archive, and each window's Claude-panel memory reading, drive VS Code through its debug port — and so can any local process, which is fine on a machine only you use. Add "remote-debugging-port": "9222" to argv.json, set Mastermind's Debug Port to 9222, then quit every VS Code window and reopen.
[Open argv.json](command:workbench.action.configureRuntimeArguments)
[Open the Debug Port setting](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%5B%22mastermind.debugPort%22%5D)
